params.description: This is the [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the compartment in which to list resources.

params.name: lifecycleState
params.description:
This is a filter to return only resources that match the given lifecycle state. The
state value is case-insensitive.

params.name: displayName
params.description: This is a filter to return only resources that match the given display name exactly.

params.name: scheduleId
params.description: This is the [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the schedule.

params.name: limit
params.description:
For list pagination. The maximum number of results per page, or items to return in a
paginated "List" call. For important details about how pagination works, see
[List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

params.name: page
params.description:
This used for list pagination. The value of the opc-next-page response header from the previous
"List" call. For important details about how pagination works, see
[List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

params.name: sortBy
params.description:
This is the field to sort by. You can provide only one sort order. The default order for `timeCreated`
is descending. The default order for `displayName` is ascending.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: This is the sort order to use, either ascending (`ASC`) or descending (`DESC`).

params.description: This is the [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the resource affected by the work request.
